scripts.average:
Sub Main()
	Dim A as Long, B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, E as Long, F as Long
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	 If IsPlaying(A) & GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
		B = B + 1
		C = C + GetPlayerLevel(A)
		If GetPlayerLevel(A) = 80 Then D = D + 1
		If GetPlayerGuild(A) > 0 Then F = F + 1
	 End If
	Next A
	E = Divide(C, B)
	F = Divide(F * 100, B)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(Str(B), " Players' Average Level:  "), Str(E)), WHITE)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat("Players at Level 80:  ", Str(D)), WHITE)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat("Guilded Population:  ", Str(F)), "%"), WHITE)
'	GlobalMessage("Players' Average IQ: 4", White)
End Sub

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 90) = 1 Then 'Cleric Res
		If GetPlayerIsDead(Player) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("res", Player, Target)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 94) = 1 Then 'Mage Telepathy
		If GetPlayerAccess(Target) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("playerscan", Player, Target)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Gods are unaffected by your pesky mind tricks.", Grey)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 96) > 0 Then 'Mage Sacrifice
		RunScript2("sacrifice", Player, Target)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 204) > 0 Then	'Mage Evil Eye
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 & GetPlayerGuild(Target) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Unguildeds may not spy on Guildeds.", Grey)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 204, 0)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your Evil Eye is now tracking ", GetPlayerName(Target)), Yellow)

				Timer(Player, 20, "Tag")

			End If
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", Grey)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 208) = 1 Then	'Cleric Damnation
		If GetPlayerIsDead(Target) = True Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) <> 2 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Target, 15, 2)
				Map = GetPlayerMap(Target)
				X = GetPlayerX(Target)
				Y = GetPlayerY(Target)
				RunScript4("Explosion", Player, Map, X, Y)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			End If
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 78) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " is one of Fank's Henchmen!"), Green)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218) > 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), strcat(" has ruled over ToF Run ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218)), " times!"))), Green)
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218) = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has ruled over ToF Run!"), Green)
		End If
	End If
'	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 125) > 0 Then
'		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has received knowledge of the Dark Arts!"), Blue)
'	End If
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Target, 215)
		Case 1
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has slain the Champ single handed!"), Red)
		Case 2
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has slain the Bremen in close quarters!"), Red)
		Case 3

		Case 4
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has stared into the eyes of Death and preveiled!"), Red)
	End Select
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 196) = 1 Then	'Cleric Damnation
			'If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) <> 2 Then

scripts.poison:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, Damage as Long, Cast as Long
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 1
Damage = Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 10)

If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "KIXFACE!", BrightGreen)


For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If Player <> Loop Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
				Cast = 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 31, Damage)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 33, Player)
				CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 18, 40, 2, 2, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has poisoned you!"), White)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "Poison1")
				Timer(Loop, 20, "PoisonCooldown")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Cast = 1 Then SetPlayerFlag(Player, 32, 1)

End Sub

scripts.killplayer:
Function Main(Killer AS LONG, Killed as LONG) as LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Killed)
X = GetPlayerX(Killed)
Y = GetPlayerY(Killed)

	'Poison
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 33, 0)
	End If

	'God Death
	If GetPlayerAccess(Killed) > 0 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	'Cleric Spell - Redemption
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 207) > 0 Then RunScript1("redemption2", Killed)

	'Minigames
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10)
		Case 1 'Carn
			RunScript2("carnkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 2 'Team Carn
			RunScript2("teamkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 3 'Battle
			RunScript2("battlekill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 4 'TTD
			RunScript2("ttdkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 6 'Big CTF
			RunScript2("ctfkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 11 'Football
			RunScript2("footballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 12 'Dodgeball
			RunScript2("dodgeballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 13 'Team Arena
			RunScript2("teamarenakill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 14 'Tournament Kill
			RunScript2("tournamentkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 16 'Snowball Tag
			RunScript2("snowballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
	End Select

	'Hell
	If GetPlayerMap(Killed) = 666 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Stake Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 13) = 3 Then
		RunScript2("stakekill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Duel Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 14) > 0 Then
		RunScript2("duelkill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1988 | GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1987 Then
		PlayerWarp(Killed, 1988, 6, 3)
		RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	If HasObj(Killed, 393) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 393, HasObj(Killed, 393))
					GiveObj(Killer, 393, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Babylon Torch!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If
	If HasObj(Killed, 389) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 389, HasObj(Killed, 389))
					GiveObj(Killer, 389, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Dragonia Candle!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If

	'Prevent being warped to town when killed in the arena
	Select Case GetPlayerMap(Killed)
		Case 1887 'Gallins House
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 2)
		Case 1962 'House of PK
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 1)
		Case Else
			SpawnObject(Map, 443, 1, X, Y)	'First Aid Kits
	End Select
	
	SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 15, 1)

	Main = Continue
End Function

scripts.map124_10_6:
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(A, 10) = 1 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
			PlayerWarp(A, 677, 5, 5)
			BootPlayer(A, "Left Guild in CTF")
		End If
	End If
Next A

'Spectator
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 30 & GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 31 Then
	Exit Function
End If

'RedTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 30 then
	exit function
end if

'BlueTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 31 then
If hasobj(player,508) then		'Has Red Flag

For A = 0 to getmaxusers
	If HasObj(A, 509) Then		'Blue Flag Gone
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
		exit function
	end if
Next A

'Blue Score
setflag(63,getflag(63)+1)
globalmessage(strcat(getplayername(player), " has scored for the Blue Team!"),white)
globalmessage(strcat("<Score> Red Team: ", strcat(str(getflag(62)),strcat(" Blue Team: ",strcat(str(getflag(63)), " <Score>")))),yellow)
takeobj(player,508,1)
setplayerstatus(player,0)
setPlayerSprite(Player, 133)
ResetMap(124)
ResetMap(149)
ResetMap(150)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
	If GetPlayerMap(A) = 124 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 149 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 150 Then
		takeobj(a,509,1)
		SetPlayerStatus(a, 0)
		SetPlayerHP(a, GetPlayerMaxHP(a))
		SetPlayerEnergy(a, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(a))
		SetPlayerMana(a, GetPlayerMaxMana(a))
			if getplayerguild(a) = 31 then
				playerwarp(a,124,8,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 133)
			End If
			if getplayerguild(a) = 30 then
				playerwarp(a,150,3,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 132)
			End If
	End If
next a

'Blue Team Wins
if getflag(63) = 5 then
 globalmessage("The Blue Team has won Capture the Flag!",brightGreen)
 setflag(62,0)
 setflag(63,0)
      
      for a = 0 to getmaxusers
		if getplayermap(a) = 124 | getplayermap(a) = 149 | getplayermap(a) = 150 then
			if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
				If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A,0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A,0)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, GetPlayerFlag(A, 5))
				Playerwarp(A, 677,5,5)	
			end if
		end if 
      next a
      Exit Function
end if

'Spawn Flags
SpawnObject(150, 508, 1, 1, 6)
SpawnObject(124, 509, 1, 10, 6)
exit function

else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 124, 9, 6)
	exit function
end if
end if

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 40

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be guilded to use this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If HasObj(Player, 407) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Blinding Powder to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Eva Nescent!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 27, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
TakeObj(Player, 407, 1)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, GetGuildSprite(GetPlayerGuild(Loop)))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
				Timer(Loop, 10, "TurnVisible3")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else

		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

SetFlag(82, 0)

SetFlag(142, 0) 'Blue Count

SetFlag(144, 5) 'Blue Kills

				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 5, 11)
			Else
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 12)
				If GetFlag(141) <= GetFlag(142) Then
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 5, 0)

					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetFlag(141, GetFlag(141) + 1)
				Else
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 6, 11)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 4)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 7)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetFlag(142, GetFlag(142) + 1)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 12 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG

   Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
      Case UP
         A = GetPlayerX(Player)
         B = GetPlayerY(Player) - 1
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B - 1
         If B < 0 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()

         Next A
      Case DOWN

         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B + 1
         If B > 10 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()

Sub Main(Player AS LONG)

	Dim Dir AS LONG, DestDir AS LONG
	Dim Map AS LONG, StartX AS LONG, StartY AS LONG
	Dim CheckX AS LONG, CheckY AS LONG
	Dim DestX AS LONG, DestY AS LONG
	Dim Damage AS LONG, Mana AS LONG
	
	Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
	StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Dir = GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Mana = 1
	Select Case Dir
		Case 0 'Up
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY - 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY - 1
			DestDir = 1
		Case 1 'Down
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY + 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY + 1
			DestDir = 0
		Case 2 'Left
			CheckX = StartX - 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX - 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 3
		Case 3 'Right
			CheckX = StartX + 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX + 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 2
	End Select
	
	'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
	If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If HasObj(Player, 298) = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You lack a required item.", Grey)
		Exit Sub	'Stabbin Dagger
	End If
'	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) <> 0 Then
'		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast so often.", Grey)
'		Exit Sub
'	End If
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting again.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Dim A AS LONG
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If IsPlaying(A) Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = Map & GetPlayerX(A) = CheckX & GetPlayerY(A) = CheckY Then
				If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
					If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						If Dir = GetPlayerDirection(A) Then
							Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 4)
							CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 38, 60, 8, 0, 0)

Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 5) = 59 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must remove your Shard to adopt a new Mindset.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) <> 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to adopt a new Mindset.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require full health to adopt a new Mindset.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 205) = 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in this Mindset.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 205, 2)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You have adopted a Heroic Mindset.", White)
CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 50, 80, 8, 0, 0)

End Sub

         Dim A as Long
         For A = 1 to 510
            If HasObj(Player, A) Then
               PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot bring anything into Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
               PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
               Exit Sub
            End If
         Next A
         SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 1)
         PlayerMessage(Player, "Welcome to Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 79, 5, 5)
      Else
         PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be a Knight to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
      End If

      PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be level 1 to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
      PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
   End If
END SUB

	Case 1 'Lumber
		Item = 215
		Flag = 130
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 2 'Coarse Ore
		Item = 216
		Flag = 131
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 3 'Flawed Ore
		Item = 217
		Flag = 132
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost - 50
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 4 'Pure Ore
		Item = 218
		Flag = 133
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 500 Then Cost = 500
			Cost = Cost - 100
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 5 'Small Fish
		Item = 153
		Flag = 134
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 6 'Medium Fish
		Item = 152
		Flag = 135
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost - 50
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 7 'Big Fish
		Item = 148
		Flag = 136
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 40)
			If Cost < 500 Then Cost = 500
			Cost = Cost - 100
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must select which resource you wish to sell.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
End Select

If Ammount = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You must select how much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " you wish to sell.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > HasObj(Player, Item) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You dont have that much ", GetObjectName(Item)), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > 100 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may only sell in lots upto 100 items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
TakeObj(Player, Item, Ammount)
GiveObj(Player, 6, Cost)
SetFlag(Flag, GetFlag(Flag) + Ammount)
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have sold ", strcat(str(Ammount), strcat(" ", GetObjectName(Item)))), White)
RunScript0("refreshmarket")

End Sub

scripts.tournamentwarp:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Flag as Long, Count as Long, Cost as Long
Cost = GetFlag(180)

If GetFlag(170) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Tournament is already in progress.", Grey)
'	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Player)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetFlag(80) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The tournament arena is closed.", Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

If HasObj(Player, 6) < Cost Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to enter this Tournament.")), Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

Count = 0
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) = 0 Then
		Select Case Flag
			Case 171
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 6)
			Case 172
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 8)
			Case 173
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 6)
			Case 174
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 8)
			Case 175
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 6)
			Case 176
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 8)
			Case 177
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 6)
			Case 178
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 8)
		End Select
		SetFlag(Flag, Player)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 14)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
		SetFlag(179, GetFlag(179) + Cost)
		GoTo EndLoop
	End If
Next Flag
PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)

EndLoop:
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
Next Flag

If Count = 8 Then
	MapMessage(1883, strcat("The Tournament Prize Pot is ", strcat(str(GetFlag(179)), " Gold!")), Yellow)
	RunScript0("TournamentRound1")
End If

End Sub
scripts.tournamentstart:
Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, Flag as Long
dim Count as Long

Count = 0
If GetFlag(171) = 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
			For Flag = 171 To 178
				If GetFlag(Flag) = Loop Then Count = Count + 1
			Next Flag
			If Count = 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				SetFlag(171, Loop)
				GoTo EndLoop1
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetFlag(171) = 0 Then
		If GetFlag(172) > 0 Then
			'Player 1 Forfeits
			'Player 2 Wins by Default
		Else
			'Tournament Reset, not enough players
		End If
	End If
End If
EndLoop1:

Count = 0
If GetFlag(172) = 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
			For Flag = 171 To 178
				If GetFlag(Flag) = Loop Then Count = Count + 1
			Next Flag
			If Count = 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 8)
				SetFlag(172, Loop)
				GoTo EndLoop2
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetFlag(172) = 0 Then
		'Player 2 Forfeits
		'Player 1 Wins by Default
	End If
End If
EndLoop2:

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
		If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 1)
		If GetFlag(172) = Loop Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 9, 4)
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, Flag as Long
dim Count as Long, First as Long, Second as Long

	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 14 Then
			If GetFlag(172) = Loop Then
				MapMessage(1883, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " wins by default!"), Yellow)
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "TournamentRound2")
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 14 Then
			If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then
				MapMessage(1883, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " wins by default!"), Yellow)
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "TournamentRound2")
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
		If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 1)
			First = Loop
		End If
		If GetFlag(172) = Loop Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 9, 4)
			Second = Loop
		End If
	End If

End Sub

scripts.teamarena:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim RedCount as Long, BlueCount as Long, RedGate as Long, BlueGate as Long

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1443 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) <> 13 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot start a Team Battle.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "This is not the Team Arena.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then RedCount = RedCount + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then BlueCount = BlueCount + 1
			X = GetPlayerX(Loop)
			Y = GetPlayerY(Loop)
			If Y = 1 Then
				If X = 0 | X = 1 Then RedGate = RedGate + 1
				If X = 10 | X = 11 Then BlueGate = BlueGate + 1
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If RedGate < 2 | BlueGate < 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There are not enough players on the start tiles.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If

MapMessage(1443, strcat("A Team Battle has started - ", strcat(str(RedCount), strcat("v", str(BlueCount)))), Yellow)
SetFlag(153, 1)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 3 + Random(3), 1 + Random(3))
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 8 - Random(3), 6 - Random(3))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

scripts.teamarenawin:
Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, RedCount as Long, BlueCount as Long

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
			Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11)
				Case 1
					RedCount = RedCount + 1
				Case 2
					BlueCount = BlueCount + 1
			End Select
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If RedCount = 0 Then
	MapMessage(1443, "Blue Team has Won!", BrightGreen)
	SetFlag(153, 0)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 6, 10)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("You got ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills.")), White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

If BlueCount = 0 Then
	MapMessage(1443, "Red Team has Won!", BrightGreen)
	SetFlag(153, 0)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 5, 10)

				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)

				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, Mon as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant use that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to use this ability again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetTileAtt(Map, GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 11 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant use that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
'If HasObj(Player, 413) = 0 Then
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Holy Water to use this ability.", Grey)
'	Exit Sub
'End If

	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
'	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Mon En!", BrightGreen)
CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Player, 41, 40, 8, 0, 0)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case 0
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 1
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 2
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 3
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
End Select

End Sub

scripts.battlekill:
Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long

'Flag 86 = Red Score
'Flag 87 = Blue Score
'Flag 88 = Kill Limit

SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12) + 1)	'Player Scores

If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team Scores
	SetFlag(86, GetFlag(86) + 1)
	PlayerWarp(Killed, 1422, 11, 1)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 7)
	SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 101)
	MapMessage(1420, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
	MapMessage(1421, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
	MapMessage(1422, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team Scores
	SetFlag(87, GetFlag(87) + 1)
	PlayerWarp(Killed, 1421, 0, 1)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 1)
	SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 100)
	MapMessage(1420, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
	MapMessage(1421, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
	MapMessage(1422, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
End If

RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
	
'Red Team Wins
If GetFlag(86) >= GetFlag(88) Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat("Red Team wins Battle Royale with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(86)), " kills!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("Your score was ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills")), Yellow)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			SetFlag(86, 0)
			SetFlag(87, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If
'Blue Team Wins
If GetFlag(87) >= GetFlag(88) Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat("Blue Team wins Battle Royale with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(87)), " kills!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("Your score was ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills")), Yellow)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			SetFlag(86, 0)
			SetFlag(87, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Function

scripts.confuse:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long

Mana = 26
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
		RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
		SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
		CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Con Fun Dere!", BrightGreen)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
					If Loop <> Player Then
						CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
						CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
						If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23) = 0 Then
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23, 1)
								RunScript1("cooldown", Loop)
								PlayerMessage(Loop, "You become confused!", Grey)
								CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Loop, 21, 40, 8, 0, 0)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	End If
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String
dim Count as Long, Colour as Long

GlobalMessage("==Guild List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Colour = 4 Then Colour = 6 Else Colour = 4
			GlobalMessage(Message, Colour)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) >= 1 & HasObj(Player, 69) >= 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) >= 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

			End If
		Case 3

				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Gem of Valhalla!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, 438, 2)
				TakeObj(Player, 434, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 53, 1)

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
''Cook Fish

Ration = HasObj(Player, 39) + HasObj(Player, 41) + HasObj(Player, 99) + HasObj(Player, 155) + HasObj(Player, 138)

If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) & GetPlayerMana(Player) = GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) Then

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook fish", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
If Ration < 3 Then
'Big Fish => Apple
	If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 10 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 148, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 41, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Big Fish into a Candy Apple!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
'Medium Fish => Ancient Tome
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 10 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 10)
			GiveObj(Player, 99, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Medium Fish into an Ancient Tome!", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		Else
'Small Fish => HP Pot
			If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 10 Then
				TakeObj(Player, 153, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 39, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Small Fish into a Health Potion!", Yellow)
				Exit Function
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You need 10 fish to cook a meal", Grey)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not have more than 3 ration items", Grey)
End If

Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be fully restored to cook fish", Grey)
End If

End Function

scripts.cooksanc:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Count1 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
				RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
				GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
Else
	If Count2 = 0 Then
		GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
					RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
					RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
					GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
					RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightRed)
		Else
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightBlue)
		End If
	End If
End If

End Function

FUNCTION Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as String, Parm2 as String, Parm3 as String) AS LONG
Dim A As Long, B As Long, C As Long, D As Long, E As Long, Target As Long

Main = Stop
Target = FindPlayer(Parm1)

	If strcmp(Command, "Tackle") Then
		RunScript1("FootballTackle", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Command, "search") Then
		For A = 1 to 2000
			If InStr(GetMapName(A), Parm1) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(Str(A), GetMapName(A)), WHITE)
			End If
		Next A
		Exit Function
	End If

'Secondary Skills
	If strcmp(Command, "smith") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 4
				RunScript2("SmithCren", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 594
				RunScript2("SmithSanc", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 1881
				RunScript2("SmithDrag", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmith to smith.", Grey)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "cook") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 551
				RunScript2("CookCrags", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 598
				RunScript2("CookSanc", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 950
				RunScript2("CookDrag", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 1882
				RunScript2("CookBab", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a kitchen to cook.", Grey)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "craft") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 300
				RunScript2("CraftNC", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 593
				Select Case val(Parm1)
					Case 0
						RunScript1("CraftSanc", Player)
					Case 1
						RunScript2("CraftSanc2", Player, val(Parm2))

				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a workshop to craft.", Grey)

		Exit Function

scripts.push:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, Z as Long
dim Loop as Long, Map as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 76) = 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must have full Health to use Push.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")
MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used Push!"), BRIGHTRED)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		Z = Y - 1
		If Y < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		Z = Y + 1
		If Y > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		Z = X - 1
		If X < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		Z = X + 1
		If X > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
End Select

End Sub

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)


'//========Teams=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))

setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else

setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)

SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))

end if
else
end if
else

next a

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

next a

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Heal

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 2)
Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)
Health = Health + Divide(GetPlayerConcentration(Player), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
'		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
			If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
								If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								Else
									'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
								End If
							Else
								RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
							End If
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
									If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									Else
										'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
									End If
								Else
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
'		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

				GiveObj(Player, 197, 1)

		Case 3

				GiveObj(Player, 250, 1)

				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 30)
				GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)

		Case 5

Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmiths to smith.", Grey)

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, Card) <> 1 Then

		Else
			Score = Score + 10
		End If

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String, Count as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Guilds List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Guilds = 16 Then PlayerMessage(Player, Message, BrightBlue) Else PlayerMessage(Player, Message, Guilds)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Function

scripts.push2:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, A as Long, B as Long
dim Loop as Long, Map as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 76) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must order this item from the Online Store.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must have full Health to use Push.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")
MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used Push!"), BRIGHTRED)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		B = Y - 1
		A = X
		If Y < 1 Then Exit Sub
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		B = Y + 1
		A = X
		If Y > 10 Then Exit Sub
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		A = X - 1
		B = Y
		If X < 1 Then Exit Sub
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		A = X + 1
		B = Y
		If X > 10 Then Exit Sub
End Select

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
		If GetTileAtt(Map, A, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, A, B)
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

SUB Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as STRING)
'\marketview -player name-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,a as LONG,price as LONG,discoveredname as STRING

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,""), "") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,strcat("No player by the name ",strcat(Parm1," was found! Make sure the spelling is right.")),BrightRed)
   Exit SUB
Else
   discoveredname = ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,"")
End If


For slot = 1 to 15
   If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),""), "") Then
	'Empty Slot
   Else
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
      price = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot + 100),""))
      If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))),Yellow)
      Else
         specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
         specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
         specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s ",StrCat("   Price: ",str(price))))))))),Yellow)
         Else
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Durability: ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))))),Yellow)
         End If
      End If
   End If
Next slot
End SUB

SUB Main(Player as LONG)

Dim openinvslot as LONG

      End If
   Next openinvslot
End If
End SUB

Sub Main(Player as Long, Chance as Long, Object as Long)
Dim X as Long, Y as Long

X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then Y = Y - 1
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Down Then Y = Y + 1 
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Left Then X = X - 1
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Right Then X = X + 1
If X < 0 | X > 11 Then X = GetPlayerX(Player)
If Y < 0 | Y > 11 Then Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y) <> 0 Then
	X = GetPlayerX(Player)
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
End If

If Random(Chance) + 1 = 1 Then SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), Object, 1, X, Y)

End Sub

scripts.lure:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, Mon as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Mon En!", BrightGreen)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case 0
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 1
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 2
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 3
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
End Select

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim K1 as Long, K2 as Long, K3 as Long, K4 as Long
dim Direction as Long

K1 = 1
K2 = 2
K3 = 3
K4 = 4

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 110) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerX(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 1 'Left
	If GetPlayerX(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 2 'Right
	If GetPlayerY(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 3 'Up
	If GetPlayerY(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 4 'Down

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 111, Direction)
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = 0 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 112, Direction)
		Else
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 113, Direction)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 114, Direction)
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = K1 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = K2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = K3 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 114) = K4 Then
				CreateMapFloatText(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22), "Click!", BrightGreen)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they unlock!", White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
					Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
						Case 90
							RunScript1("BossKeypad", Player)
					End Select
					Exit Sub
				End If
				End If
				End If
				End If
				'RESET
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they reset.", Grey)
			End If
		End If
	End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 10) * 9
Buff = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 28) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 28, 1)
RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 4 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

scripts.heal:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
			If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

scripts.guilds:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String, Count as Long

GlobalMessage("==Guilds List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Guilds = 16 Then GlobalMessage(Message, BrightBlue) Else GlobalMessage(Message, Guilds)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Party as Long, Message as String
dim Count as Long, Count2 as Long, Colour as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Party List==", White)
Count2 = 1
For Party = 1 To 30
	Message = strcat(str(Count2), ". ")
	Count = 0
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = Party Then
				Count = Count + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202) = 1 Then
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " (Leader), "))
				Else
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If				
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If Count > 0 Then
		If Colour = 4 Then Colour = 6 Else Colour = 4
		PlayerMessage(Player, Message, Party)
		Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If
Next Party

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim X as Long, Loop as Long, Cost as Long

		  End If

	   TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)

	   PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /party invite <player> to invite others to join.", Grey)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("It costs ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to start a Party.")), Grey)
	End If
Else

End If

scripts.partyinvite:
Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Your Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 203) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have already invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your party.")), Grey)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your Party.")), White)
			PlayerMessage(Target, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has invited you to their Party. Type /party join."), White)
			SetPlayerFlag(Target, 203, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201))
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not Leader of the Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Endurance Buff

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Buff = 7

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If HasObj(Player, 413) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Holy Water to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 28) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

'If HasObj(Player, 413) Then
'	Buff = 14
'	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
'End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Tu Tela!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 28, 1)
RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 4 Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
						RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
					Else
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
								RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						Else
							SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
							PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
							RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the jacket to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)

	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. The Wizard has enchanted your jacket.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the jacket to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If

	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 4
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 6

				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 76)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 127)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 78)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 307)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(11) + 10)
			Case 4

				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)

			Case 7

				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 1)
		End Select

		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have gained 20k experience!", Green)
	Else
		GiveObj(Player, 6, 100000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have received 100k Gold Coins!", Green)
	End If
	Exit Sub
End If

If ObjNum = 0 Then	'No Current Task
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 3
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 5
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 59 Then Level = 6
		Select Case Random(Level)
			Case 0
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 48)	'Sushi
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 113)	'Fruit
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 69)	'Marshroom
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 103)	'Carrot
			Case 4
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 198)	'Cookie
			Case 5
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 41)	'Candy Apple
		End Select
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''Looking to make yourself useful kid? Go bring me a ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), ".''")), White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, ObjNum) Then	'Task Complete
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 244, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 244) + 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You successfully complete the errand!", BrightGreen)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Cheers for that kid.''", White)
		If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 48
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 10k Experience!", Green)
				Case 113
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 20k Experience!", Green)
				Case 69
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 30000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 30k Experience!", Green)
				Case 103
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 40000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 40k Experience!", Green)
				Case 198
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Experience!", Green)
				Case 41
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Experience!", Green)
			End Select
		Else
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 198
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 41
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 60000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Gold!", Green)
			End Select
		End If
	Else 'Task Incomplete
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''You found that ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), " yet kid?''")), White)
	End If
End If

End Sub

dim Map as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	If Map = 66 | Map = 67 | Map = 85 | Map = 87 | Map = 88 | Map = 91 | Map = 93 | Map = 98 | Map = 148 | Map = 167 | Map = 231 | Map = 232 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Target) & GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
		'Players can resurrect their own guild
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect those killed by man.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 2 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If

		CreatePlayerEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, Target, 31, 40, 8, 0)

	End If

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim EnchantCost as Long
	EnchantCost = 80000
	if strcmp(message,"enchant ring") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Dim Prefix as Long
			 Dim PrefixID as Long
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("Taylor Tailor says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
	Dim PurgeCost as Long
	PurgeCost = 10000
	if strcmp(message,"purge ring") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

Function Main(Player as Long) as Long
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Dir as Long, Loop as Long, Ran as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Ran = Random(2) + 1

For Loop = 1 To Ran
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		If X < 0 Then
			If Map = 1423 Then
				Goto Backwards
			Else
				Map = Map - 1
				X = 11
			End If
		End If
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		If X > 11 Then
			If Map = 1425 Then
				Goto Backwards
			Else
				Map = Map + 1
				X = 0
			End If
		End If
End Select

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 11 Then	'Goal
	ResetMap(GetPlayerMap(Player))
	RunScript1("FootballWarp", Map)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then
		RunScript2("FootballRedGoal", Player, Map)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then
		RunScript2("FootballBlueGoal", Player, Map)
	End If
	Exit Function
End If
If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 0 Then
'	DestroyObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0)
'	DestroyObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1)
	ResetMap(GetPlayerMap(Player))
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, X, Y)
Else
Backwards:
	Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
		Case Up
			Y = Y + 2
		Case Down
			Y = Y - 2
		Case Left
			X = X + 2
		Case Right
			X = X - 2
	End Select
	'DestroyObject(Map, 0)
	'DestroyObject(Map, 1)
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, X, Y)
	Exit Function
End If
Next Loop

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to create potions.", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If

If Ration < 3 Then
'20 Marshrooms => Vigorous Potion
	If HasObj(Player, 403) & HasObj(Player, 286) >= 10 & HasObj(Player, 69) >= 20 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 69, 20)
		TakeObj(Player, 403, 1)
		TakeObj(Player, 286, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 446, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Marshroom into a Vigorous Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

scripts.partyjoin:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) > 0 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "That Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203))
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 203, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have joined a Party!", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "To leave the party type /party leave.", White)
		RunScript1("partylist", Player)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If Player <> Loop Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
					PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has joined your Party."), White)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have not been invited to a Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function
scripts.partyleave:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Leader as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has left your Party."), White)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				Leader = Loop
				Goto Finish
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

Finish:
RunScript2("partyleader", Player, Leader)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You are no longer part of any Party.", Grey)

End Function

Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
'Thief - Quick Strike
	Dim Dir AS LONG, DestDir AS LONG
	Dim Map AS LONG, StartX AS LONG, StartY AS LONG
	Dim CheckX AS LONG, CheckY AS LONG
	Dim DestX AS LONG, DestY AS LONG
	Dim Damage AS LONG, Mana AS LONG
	
	Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
	StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Dir = GetPlayerDirection(Player)
'	If HasObj(Player, 298) = 0 Then Mana = 50 Else Mana = 1
	Mana = GetPlayerMaxMana(Player)
	Select Case Dir
		Case 0 'Up
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY - 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY - 1
			DestDir = 1
		Case 1 'Down
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY + 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY + 1
			DestDir = 0
		Case 2 'Left
			CheckX = StartX - 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX - 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 3
		Case 3 'Right
			CheckX = StartX + 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX + 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 2
	End Select
	
	'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
	If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting again.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 5 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 11 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 17 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim A AS LONG
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If IsPlaying(A) & GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = Map & GetPlayerX(A) = CheckX & GetPlayerY(A) = CheckY Then
				If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
					If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
						If Dir = GetPlayerDirection(A) Then
							Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 3)
							CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 38, 60, 8, 0, 0)
						Else
							If (Dir = 0 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 2) Then
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
								Exit Sub
							Else
								Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 5)
								CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 66, 60, 8, 0, 0)
							End If
						End If
						AttackPlayer(Player, A, Damage)
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
	
	For A = 0 to 5
		If GetMonsterType(Map, A) > 0 & GetMonsterX(Map, A) = CheckX & GetMonsterY(Map, A) = CheckY Then
			If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
				If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
					If (Dir = 0 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 2) Then
						PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
						Exit Sub
					Else
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 4)
	'					AttackMonster(Player, A, Damage)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
End Sub
