Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Gate as Long
'Thief Hide Others
Mana = 30
If RunScript1("CheckMap", Player) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) <> 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need full Health to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
End Select

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Player) = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25) = 0 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) = 0 Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
							If Player <> Loop Then
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 21, GetPlayerX(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 22, GetPlayerY(Loop))
								SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
								SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 255)
								Timer(Loop, 20, "TurnVisible")
								Timer(Loop, 1, "Invis1")
								Gate = 1
							End If
						else
							PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
						end if
					else
						PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
					end if
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "Target cannot hide yet.", Grey)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
If Gate = 1 Then 'Worked
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 61, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 57, 40, 8, 0, 0)
Else
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 52, 40, 8, 0, 0)
End If

End Sub

1.SayText1: Weapons, Armours, we offer it all!
1.SayText0: I sell the finest in weapons and armors!
1.SayText2: My weapons will assuredly slay thine enemies!
1.JoinText: Welcome, we offer the finest in weapons and armour.  I'm working 'round the clock now, we must prepare for the honorable King Dekkar III has declared it! Always trusted them Dekkars', gold folk I tell you.
1.SayText3: Nothing is finer than a Garad crafted Stabbin' Dagger!
1.LeaveText: Bye, good luck on your travels.  Get your weapons while you can!
1.Name: Garad

2.SayText1: Don't trust potions you find lying around, could be toxic.
2.SayText0: Potions are good business if you know what your doing.
2.SayText4: You can't tell the difference between good and bad potions.
2.JoinText: Welcome to my lab of alchemy, young one.
2.SayText3: I also buy toxic healing potions if you find some.
2.Name: Granny Korgins

3.SayText1: Them guilds is always fighting, not like the glory days of King Dekkar I
3.SayText0: Business is good these days, what with the shadow wars.
3.SayText2: The rifts between worlds increasin'. Lots of strange demons n stuff poppin in.
3.JoinText: Something big and bad's gonna happen soon. I can feel it.  I've been feeling it for the past 7 years now..I sure love fish, don't you? All fish restaurant's comin next!
3.SayText3: Something big and bad's gonna happen soon. I can feel it.
3.LeaveText: ..you all thought I was crazy...but now..now you'll see...NOW you listen to the Oracle..never listen to me..never...*mumbles*
3.Name: The Barkeep

4.SayText1: I'll buy boats back that you find.
4.SayText4: Rowboats are only useful in some areas.
4.SayText2: I sell the most finest boats in the land!
4.JoinText: Welcome to my humble boat store.  I am not worried at all.  King Dekkar III will protect us from anything.  The Dekkars always have.
4.Name: Erlington

5.SayText1: Ya hear they be buildin' up a new town to the south? Aye...Riverdale tis its name
5.SayText0: Ar, lads. The seas be fine today.
5.SayText4: Arr, I be hating them elves in the forest.
5.SayText2: I used ta be an adventurer o' da high seas until they took me hand!
5.JoinText: Arr, welcome to me cap'ns table
5.SayText3: Ye hear that an old pyramid got uncovered in the Draconis Wastes, aye?
5.LeaveText: Ye be comin' back soon, aye?
5.Name: Cap'n Cook

6.SayText1: Leather armor's more popular in peace time. Not with these shadow wars..
6.SayText0: Not much demand for leather these days.
6.SayText4: Come to think of it, I should just get rid of my last leather good and be a sole lumber merchant.
6.SayText2: Our leather is made from troll skin. Cows are rare in these parts.
6.JoinText: Welcome to me shop, I sell wooden and leather goods.  With a supply of Lumber, I can make an assortment of items, including Paper!
6.SayText3: The trees around here are magical, and never fully get chopped down no matter how much wood you cut from 'em! They say it has something to do with that crazy Horticulturist.
6.LeaveText: Hope ta see ye again.  Bring me more lumber!
6.Name: Madargan Gar

7.SayText1: Volume, volume, volume. And even then I don't make much.
7.SayText0: The Tools o' Trade, yet sometimes The Tools o' Scamming!
7.SayText2: I should just sell this stuff instead.
7.SayText3: Who would trade Scorpion stingers for an Old Raft anyways?
7.Name: Trader Jim

8.SayText1: I proposed to my wife with a Sapphire ring. She was unimpressed to say the least.
8.SayText0: We can exchange goods for quick cash.
8.JoinText: Welcome, my friend, to the Crendale Bank.  Type /bank to deposit and withdraw your gold and items.  I never believed the barkeep before...fools we were! Now its too late! AH
8.LeaveText: Please Come again.  Store your valuables here! Our vault is barricaded finer than any in the kingdom.  Whatever comes, they'll be safe, even if you're not!
8.Name: Banker Tyler

9.SayText1: I love the smell of the sea breeze.
9.SayText0: Having a nice day, aren't we?
9.SayText4: I made my dog a little house from coolie hats.
9.SayText2: I'll buy back wolf and other exotic pelts
9.JoinText: Welcome to my store, I sell furs and clothing.
9.SayText3: Come to think of it, I don't know ANY horticulturists...
9.Name: Tailor Taylor

10.SayText1: Hates me those trolls...greasy, barbaric fellows. Here they got scouts in these parts.
10.SayText0: The trolls are moving in an army, that's apparent enough. Damn scouts everywhere.
10.SayText4: Dragonia's the capitol. Bah, King Dekkar III is a fool.
10.SayText2: Forests full of bandits these days. Not safe for anyone anywhere.
10.JoinText: Hey there, yun' un, whatcha doin' here? Since you ar' here though, I am in dire need of an outsiders aid.  Ya' see, my daughters very sick with Suoitanes, but I am far too old to get any Aitercul root myself...I would be very greatful if you could help.
10.SayText3: Got any wine?  Buy it off ya
10.LeaveText: Ok, good bye and good luck! If that old witch Hilda is still alive, she may have some Aitercul root laying around somewhere..
10.Name: The Hermit

11.SayText1: Beware the power of the elvish blade
11.SayText0: The elves are migrating to your lands. We shall soon overrun them if you are not careful.
11.JoinText: What are you doing here? Oh if I only had some cake! or something better....mmmmm....
11.SayText3: You may think our village small, but it will soon blossom across this entire island.
11.Name: Chief Syltanath

12.SayText1: Most of the elves do not like the humans.
12.SayText0: I do not mind where the gold comes from as long as I receive some.
12.SayText4: You know who we REALLY hate though? Dwarves.
12.JoinText: Hmm...I suppose I can sell to you, even though you are not one of us.
12.SayText3: Sell me your chainmail, we can use it.
12.Name: Elvish Merchant

13.SayText1: I will buy old armor and weapons off you
13.SayText0: I buy shields, and many other things
13.SayText4: Just raised the selling price of plate!
13.SayText2: I buy only the finest weapons
13.JoinText: Ah welcome, I buy and sell armor.
13.Name: Borrigarn

14.SayText1: I lent my brother my copy of the Da'Vinci Code. If you see him, could you ask for it back?
14.SayText0: If you ever meet my brother Varakarad, be sure to say hi.
14.SayText4: I wonder where that chimney goes up to.
14.SayText2: Gardening is one of my favorite hobbies, when I'm not being attacked by graverobbers.
14.JoinText: Congratulations!  Would you care for a cup of tea?  Or perhaps some caviar.  or perhaps some ink? I just really need a candle, it's so dark in here!
14.SayText3: Different demons prefer different atmospheres. I like living among the dead, my brother likes the ice, and my cousin, the Elder of Flames, prefers, well, you can imagine.
14.LeaveText: Excuse me for my form, but that damn V'drazzig caused this and he's hiding in that tower at the east coast, if he was here! I would crush him into bits!
14.Name: Golgatha

15.SayText1: YOU'D be angry too if your testicles froze off.
15.SayText2: You look perplexed; all yetis can talk, but we'd rather just kill you instead.
15.JoinText: Flaming scoundrels! I'll have your heart someday...on a platter! Ventures into the warmest place in the land...molten earth hell!
15.LeaveText: It's getting warmer and warmer around these parts.....
15.Name: Angry Yeti

16.SayText2: I'll buy all sorts of swords from you.
16.JoinText: Welcome to my shop of arms.
16.SayText3: I melt down the swords I buy and smith them into sturdy maces.
16.Name: Jacobson

17.SayText1: I hear there are special mineral veins around the world, so I was searching for them, and then fell down here.
17.SayText0: I knew I should have just stayed in the Crendale mines.
17.SayText2: I saw some creepy knights to the north, need to get out of here..
17.JoinText: I seem to have taken the wrong trail.  Can you point me in the direction towards the mountain? This sledge hammers getting heavy....I need some damned cigarettes..fresh out...fates not goin' my way...
17.LeaveText: Fine! Just like that time I fell down a hole and nobody would help me out...inconsiderate #@$@#$...
17.Name: Lost Miner

18.SayText1: I will buy your old shields.
18.SayText0: I sell shields and only shields.
18.SayText4: Never go into battle without a sturdy shield.
18.JoinText: Welcome to Shelly's House of Shields. I'm Shelly.
18.SayText3: I like safety. That's why I live in Dragonia. It's a safe town.
18.Name: Shelly

19.SayText1: Some trolls want to hurt this land. Come through gate. Readying army. Not me.
19.SayText0: I am far from me homes. Me homes across the magic gate. Troll land.
19.SayText4: The troll army plan to invade soon. They will kill me as a traitor. :(
19.SayText2: I live here now. Sell weapons. Buy weapons. Far from troll home.
19.SayText3: Not many places troll can show face here.
19.Name: Trankor

20.SayText1: You look like a dangerous sort, don't start any trouble here, ok?
20.SayText0: King Dekkar III is concerned about the large number of orcs and trolls in the woods.
20.SayText2: The King is losing control over the guilds.
20.SayText3: That bard is really starting to get on my nerves...
20.Name: The Tavernkeep

21.SayText1: Can't teach ya magic, nope, sorry.
21.SayText0: I'll buy scorpion stings fer me magic.
21.SayText4: I always need me more of dem snake skins!
21.SayText2: Some spells aren't in the game yet, hehe.
21.JoinText: Ah, welcome welcome. Be ye lookin' fer magicks?
21.SayText3: Raised the price of the boots, they're damn popular!
21.LeaveText: Well, good luck on whatever it is you do.
21.Name: The Old Wizard

23.JoinText: Huhhuh...Welcome ta muh House o Garbage
23.SayText3: I always have the best solutions for your useless junk!
23.LeaveText: Yup. Lots o repeat business here.
23.Name: Robert Brodsty

24.SayText1: The elves think they can move into our lands. I call to brave warriors to help dissuade them.
24.SayText0: These are troubled times. Gateways to other worlds are opening...trolls, orcs...and darker things are coming through.
24.SayText4: The worst of it are the guild wars...our own kingdom crumbles from within.
24.SayText2: No one knows where the demons come from...barquests, elder nightmares and worse...they come from the gates beyond.
24.JoinText: Welcome to my castle, adventurer.  I seem to have misplaced my boots.
24.SayText3: Though the seven shepherds are now gone, there are those who still pray to the dark lord Kair-Norax. They are lost to us.
24.LeaveText: Help keep the lands safe, warrior.  I'm sure those old men in Babylon would have good use for a Cane.
24.Name: King Dekkar III

25.SayText1: Can't ever have too good of a helmet!
25.SayText0: The secret to helms is volume, volume, volume!
25.SayText4: Some people say I've already lost my head! Haha!
25.JoinText: Welcome to my store, I sell, buy and trade helms!
25.SayText3: You lose your head...you lose your life!
25.Name: Heinrich

26.SayText1: I'm a diamond kind of guy!
26.SayText0: Good credit, bad credit...you get no credit here!
26.SayText2: I'm a Credit Man! Too bad you're not getting any here
26.JoinText: Welcome to Pol's Ruby Center, bank of Dragonia.
26.Name: Pol

27.SayText1: Once I followed the Shepherd Allistar, but I was seduced by the power of Kair-Norax.
27.SayText0: I am cursed to forever haunt these walls for my greed.
27.SayText4: I am cursed to forever haunt these walls for my greed.
27.SayText2: The Shepherds may be dead, but their power lives on!
27.JoinText: You have solved my pyramid. Type /buy to receive your reward.
27.SayText3: I was cursed by the same powers that I used to destroy others in life.
27.LeaveText: The Firerune creates a copy of the two swords I used in life!
27.Name: The Dead King

28.SayText1: I heard some guys saying there were better ninjas. F*ing unbelievable!
28.SayText0: I can't take damage...cuz I'm a ninja!
28.SayText4: I always save vrs. attacks. That's the way of the ninja!
28.JoinText: You are in THE best store in all of Dragonia.
28.Name: Nathan

29.SayText1: Most of my items are rare throughout the land.
29.SayText2: The value of my items are worth the price.
29.JoinText: Greetings! Behold my wears, of such you never did see!
29.Name: Maloch

30.SayText0: I don't get much visitors around here :(
30.SayText2: Can you help me sir? I am in need of a rope!
30.JoinText: Welcome, how can i be of assistance...
30.Name: Fisherman

31.JoinText: Don't tread on the flowers! It is difficult for them to grow in such light conditions! I really wish I had some iron rich soil, it might balance out this light situation.
31.SayText3: Watch your step you overgrown clod-hopper!
31.Name: Horticulturist

32.SayText1: Maybe the Horticulterist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
32.SayText0: Something bright an pink and flowery. That's what I need.
32.SayText4: Maybe the Horticulturist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
32.SayText2: I wish I had a plant or flower or something to brighten up this place.
32.JoinText: Dirty dank hut. What I really need are some flowers to brighten it up.
32.LeaveText: Maybe the Horticulterist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
32.Name: Dirt Hermit

33.SayText1: Are the lice bothering you as much as they are me?
33.SayText0: Don't forget to wash between your toes!
33.SayText2: I'm starving! Looking at you almost makes me lose my appetite.
33.JoinText: Oh. It's you again. My other place looks so much better now. I came out here to look for some food because I was hungry. You wouldn't have any food would you?
33.SayText3: Criminy. It should be illegal to smell like you do. Just don't wave to anyone. Those armpits should be registered as lethal weapons of war. *phew*
33.Name: Dirt Hermit

34.SayText1: Oh I *do* hate getting my pretty little feet wet!
34.SayText0: Please do hurry sir! For I'm going to see my auntie soon!
34.SayText4: Laa laa laa... la tee da....
34.SayText2: If only there was something on which to step...
34.JoinText: Excuse me kind sir, but could you please help me across the stream? There are no stones on which to step, and I'm in a most perilous predicament!
34.Name: Traveler

35.SayText1: As if I really have nothing better to do than listen to you ramble on...
35.SayText0: While you're here, could you help me find my pipe? I just can't remember where I left it...
35.SayText4: There's just nothing quite like a hot, fresh muffin!
35.JoinText: How in Kankennon's name did you get in here?
35.SayText3: I wonder what V'Drazzig is doing these days...
35.LeaveText: Why won't people just leave me alone? Its obvious I want to be left alone when I built my sanctuary deep in a church. God knows what you were doing here.
35.Name: Trizarhn

36.SayText1: I have some really good stuff in this chest, but I lost the key!
36.SayText0: I used to sell picks, but King Dekkar didn't approve.
36.SayText4: I just love keys. There's something...spiritual about them!
36.SayText2: My brother Willy recently opened up a locksmith shop.  He's not even a real locksmith!  He just buys exotic keys for his own use!
36.JoinText: Locked out of the house again, eh?
36.SayText3: If it's too rusty, don't even bother.
36.LeaveText: It's an open and shut case!
36.Name: Locksmith Chuck

37.SayText1: Oh Banker Taylor? Why he's my brother in law! I'm so happy he's doing well.
37.SayText0: We offer the finest in banking establishements this side of the Great Desert!
37.SayText2: A penny saved is a penny earned you know.
37.JoinText: Hello! How may I help you?
37.Name: Banker Wendy

38.SayText1: Take this here knife. See that blade? DON'T TOUCH IT! AUGH! SOMEONE CALL AN AMBULANCE!!!
38.SayText0: And this blade here... why it'll cut ye' open like a melon.
38.JoinText: Greetings noble warrior! There is great trouble abroad. I can even hear strange noises coming from this shop at night! I think there is a hidden tunnel in here somewhere.
38.SayText3: No kids or pets allowed... sorry. The cleanup-bill became way too costly. How do you think we painted our floor red? We certainly didn't *intend* for it to turn that color.
38.LeaveText: Fight evil, and beware of the dark side. It's dangerous outside now!
38.Name: Boris

39.JoinText: Welcome to my humble shop of shields
39.Name: Lofgan

40.SayText0: *...oh she'll be comin' 'round the mountain when she comes...*
40.SayText4: *...it's a wonderful day in the neighborhood... a wonderful day for a neighbor...*
40.SayText2: *...the ants came marching three by three... hurrah... hurrah...*
40.JoinText: Greetings traveler! Let me regale you with a jonty tune!
40.Name: Bard

41.SayText1: A noble citizen... yes! A noble citezen of Babylon I was... but no... the yonder ogre stole all that from me! Even if I knew the way I could never return to my wonderful city! No. Never.
41.SayText0: HAHAHA! They're coming to take me away haha! They're coming to take me away! hehe
41.SayText4: That evil ogre stole the best years of my life!
41.SayText2: bloo blah blah bloo blee blahhahahahaha!
41.JoinText: AAAH! GO AWAY! The owner of yonder castle is a monster! An ogre! He kept me imprisioned... but I escaped! Yes! I escaped! I stay here to warn travelers about it! I wish to God in Heaven that there was a way he would go away!
41.LeaveText: Warn others away! Just DON'T GO INTO THE CASTLE! For the orge within would surely kill you!
41.Name: Mad Woman

42.SayText0: You can't kill me! For I am protected by magic. The same magic which curses me is yet my blessing. *sigh*
42.JoinText: HAHA! Another human to attempt his little "quest". haha. Go ahead and kill me then puny human.
42.LeaveText: I beat you! Just like everyone! You can't do anything against me. For you are powerless.
42.Name: Ogre King

43.JoinText: You entered the castle and lived! Surely he was in a good mood. Here. Take this magic charm, and use it to counter his magic!
43.Name: Mad Woman

44.SayText1: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.SayText0: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.SayText4: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.SayText2: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.JoinText: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.SayText3: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
44.LeaveText: Thankyou good sir! Now that I have been transformed, she is very weak and vulnerable. But she sacficed that for the mere chance of my destruction. Kill her. She will rise again. Kill her then, and again, and don't stop until you have your reward.
44.Name: Ogre King

45.SayText0: I will never tell you! haha!
45.SayText4: Enough! Fine! I will tell you! I have hidden it behind the north-east pillar of the castle! Enough!
45.SayText2: You may kill me... but I will continue to haunt you!
45.JoinText: AAH! I can still feel his presence! You didn't kill him! He must have turned you! No! I know what you want. I have hidden the ring here. You may kill me a million times. But my magic will bring me back.
45.Name: Mad Woman

46.JoinText: Greetings noble warrior! Sorry the place is such a mess.  A man only has two hands!
46.Name: Medeas

47.SayText1: Please. Buy a helmet. Preferrably a full-face mask. You would do us all a favor.
47.SayText0: You look just like I feel.
47.SayText2: Ouch. Get hit in the face with a weedwacker? Should have had one of my helmets.
47.JoinText: What do you want? A helmet? These are probably too small. You can look anyway.
47.Name: Old Skull

48.SayText1: The Great Pyramid is not very far from here... and I often hear of its many adventures within.
48.SayText0: Have you heard of the Great Tower Works that the king is thinking of starting? What a grand idea!
48.JoinText: I am very skilled in the art of mapmaking, if you ever need one.  If you have Ink and Paper, walk infront of me to receive one.
48.LeaveText: Oh *do* enjoy your stay here! And come here frequently! Up the stairs you will find rooms that we frequently let to passing guilds. To the left is a training room for aspiring adventurers.
48.Name: Page

49.SayText1: I have my eye on you.
49.SayText0: These items can only be used only by the worthy.
49.JoinText: *Cough* *Cough*Please stay a while.  Oh dear! My wedding is approaching more rapidly than I thought..and still no wedding dress!!!!
49.SayText3: I need a Gown for my wedding night.
49.LeaveText: Arrrrrr....now I just need to find a husband...*smirk*
49.Name: Hilda

50.SayText1: I hope you find out wine tasty and our food delicious.
50.SayText0: We sell stuff to warm your bones in this cold place.
50.SayText2: Better bundle up, I hear a blizzards coming.
50.JoinText: Hello! Welcome to the Tundra Tavern.
50.Name: Willard

51.SayText1: Oh, my poor acking back, this cold just isn't good for it.
51.JoinText: Welcome to We Buy Skin, what can I do for you?
51.LeaveText: Better keep those hides comin', we need to keep warm clothes on everyone.
51.Name: Grandma Grusome

52.JoinText: Whazzup Homey? Wanna' buy a one-way ticket to Crendale or a ticket down the mountain? You might want to get back there sometime. I got dem things REAL cheap. For a small fee I'll let you through my portal to my second-cousin Gandalf's house.
52.LeaveText: Have a nice trip! tee hee hee
52.Name: Willy da Wizad

53.SayText1: Why do you continue to bother me, human?
53.SayText0: I just want to read in peace!
53.SayText4: I just finished The Da'Vinci Code.. It was exquisite.
53.SayText2: I shall RIP THE FLESH FROM YOUR BONES.
53.JoinText: Damn humans, just leave me alone.
53.SayText3: Say, you don't happen to have a copy of The Count of Monte Cristo, do you?
53.Name: Varakarad

54.JoinText: I can make the greatest gourmet meal in all the lands! That's what I do! All day long....it's really getting boring...too bad I have nothing else to do...
54.Name: Castle Cook

55.JoinText: You have solved the garden quest. The power of the land shall enchant the simple leather which lies here. Take this equipment and purify the Golgotha lurking deep inside of the Haunted House.
55.Name: The Voice

56.SayText1: A box of Magic Stars is enough for three large bowls of cereal.
56.SayText0: Muffins are good with honey and butter.
56.SayText2: If you want the best, try Kank's Cake!
56.JoinText: Welcome to the most famous bakery in the land! You know what this place could use? FLOWERS! I hear some big shot fella' of the Elves loves cake.  Eh?
56.SayText3: Kank's Donuts are made with only the finest of ingredients.
56.Name: Chef Brockett

57.SayText1: For every one you kill, another takes it's place!
57.SayText0: The G'Loritches entered the tower through a rift gate.
57.SayText4: Someday, maybe V'Drazzig will return to his tower...
57.SayText2: A horde of those creatures ran V'Drazzig out of his own tower.
57.JoinText: How did you ever make it past those beasts?
57.SayText3: I'll gladly reward you for each G'Loritch you slay.
57.LeaveText: Good luck fighting those foul denizens!
57.Name: Tower Hermit

58.SayText0: There has to be some way of getting rid of the savages...
58.SayText4: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
58.SayText2: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
58.SayText3: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
58.Name: Amazon Chief

59.SayText1: I sure hate those damned G'Loritches!
59.SayText0: My portals will take you to wherever you wish to go.
59.SayText4: I sure do miss my comfy tower...
59.SayText2: Learn from my mistakes--Never open portals into the outer realms!
59.JoinText: You have journeyed far to find me, adventurer!
59.SayText3: They just can't be endless. Keep killing those things, they should eventually all die.
59.LeaveText: Say hello to Trizarhn for me...
59.Name: Tower Keeper

60.JoinText: ~Trade your Viking Sword for a Wand of Icarus here~
60.Name: Un Voz Uno

61.JoinText: ~Trade King's Wrappings for a Skullblade here~
61.Name: Un Voz Dos

62.SayText1: To the east is an All Players Arena! Enjoy the stay and happy fighting!
62.JoinText: Welcome to the arena! You can bank by typing /bank, and you may also repair your items here!
62.LeaveText: Good luck in your battle! Let the games begin!
62.Name: Referee Garlic

63.SayText1: Now where did I put that elixir?
63.SayText0: The book of shadows holds the key.
63.SayText2: The book of shadows holds the key.
63.SayText3: The book of shadows holds the key.
63.Name: Bremen

64.SayText1: My father once told me a tale about a great beast with fur as soft as silk...
64.SayText0: These lovely furs make such nice clothing.
64.SayText4: 'Tis a lovely day, is it not?
64.SayText2: My father once went out in search of the greatest treasure he could think of.
64.SayText3: I wonder what became of my father...
64.Name: Amazon Dealer

65.SayText0: My days of fighting are over, now I just deal in arms.
65.SayText4: I hear that the amazon chief wants the head of the savage leader.
65.SayText2: Test out what you buy on our state of the art dummies.
65.SayText3: I wish I could bash in some savage skull again.
65.LeaveText: Be sure to hit 'em once for me.
65.Name: Billy Bob Joe

66.JoinText: This volcanic soil is so RICH! I WILL get RICH off this! RICH RICH RICH! AHAHAHAHA *EVIL LAUGH* RICH! but all i've ever wanted is my teddy back...my teddy!!!!!! *cries*
66.Name: Archeologist

67.JoinText: I traded my life savings to a traveling bard for this wonderful, soggy teddy bear, and now the eye has fallen out.  ARGH.  Woe is me...I came out here to "find myself" and now I cannot find my way back..I hate it here! *whimpers*
67.LeaveText: I just wish I could be with my husband again..
67.Name: Ylloh

68.JoinText: I've been searching the land for my wife for 2 years now, and I will not stop till I die! She ran off to "find herself"...I hope she's alright! Too bad she did not take a map...us Dragonians can't make 'em as well as them Babylonians though..
68.LeaveText: I'm SO hungry! I'd kill for a Gourmet meal...or even give up my trusty candle...it could really brighten up a bachelors nightshaded home..
68.Name: Kcirtap

69.SayText1: My killer runs free, breathing the air...tasting the sweet nectar of life...
69.SayText0: Murdered in life, I walk this place forever...
69.SayText4: There is no key to unlock my endless suffering...
69.SayText2: Though my body can break, it always reforms...
69.JoinText: I forever am locked in this tomb....
69.SayText3: Try your best to slay me, for if you fail, my vengeance is swift...
69.Name: Tormengus

70.SayText1: And if humming isn't enough, I chant mantras. *Deeyuyudeeararelyudee*
70.SayText0: When I am bored, I just hum... *Yuelelareldeedeearelel*
70.SayText4: Care for a game of chess? I almost always win!
70.SayText2: I just love orbs! So round, so perfect...
70.JoinText: Yawn! I didn't notice you come in...
70.SayText3: I heard somewhere that it takes five different keys to cross the Warp Bridge...
70.LeaveText: Please come again. I rarely have visitors.
70.Name: Old Man Higgins

71.SayText1: This place uses locks from all over the world!
71.SayText0: So many doors...so many keys! Where all of the keys???
71.SayText4: Higgins always wins at chess. He has a method that works every time!
71.JoinText: Ha ha ha... You think you can challenge the Tomb of Tormengus??? Barrel of fun? BARREL OF FUN! Barrel of fun.  Barrel? FUN! Barrel...FUN? of???! FUN!!!!!? BARREL????????????
71.SayText3: Higgins is hiding around here somewhere. I just can't find his door.
71.LeaveText: You're doomed! Do you hear me? DOOMED!
71.Name: Crazy Agnes

72.SayText1: The day the Boston Tea Party happened there was so much caffein in the water, the fish went so fast that not one fisherman got a bite for near 2 days!
72.SayText0: They say this stuff is bad for yer liver. I don't buy that.
72.SayText4: *aaah*.... that coffee really brings you to yer knees 'eh boy?
72.JoinText: What can I get you guys today?
72.SayText3: I had a monkey once... but then he ran away and broke my organ on the way out, so I had to take up this here coffee grinding business.
72.Name: Coffee Grinder

73.SayText1: *Oh I've... been workin' on the raaaaail road. Aaaaaaall the live long daaaaaaaay...*
73.SayText0: Those grains are so very small, but they recently have been, strangely, in glass jars!
73.SayText4: That oasis is just over the horizon again. Want to take another shot at it billy?" Crazy Geologist says, "Not right now. My feet hurt. Maybe later?" Crazy Geologist says, "Okay. Tomorrow then.
73.SayText2: They say that prolonged exposure in the desert leads to blindness and insanity. But honestly, doesn't that cactus over there look hot? Those lips of hers are just so puckery. *woo*
73.JoinText: AUGH. I'll never find enough of the rare sand particles to conduct my experiments, for they are carried by the invisible wraiths which plague these lands. Oh I would pay anything for a handful of those grains!
73.SayText3: ....water... water... nowhere... and not a drop to drink....
73.Name: Crazy Geologist

74.SayText1: I had a dream that in 300 years the "Alpha" will come. I am certain what this vision means.
74.SayText0: I have seen much in my days, but I find the more I learn the less I know.
74.SayText4: This place is a fortress, built many ages ago. No one truly lives within the confines of the castle.
74.SayText2: Without the guidance of the Shepherds, I fear we have been lost to squabbling and anarchy.
74.JoinText: Well met there. I hope you are enjoying the fine castle here at Dragonia. This fortress is quite large, I hope you do not lose your way.
74.SayText3: These are sad times in which we live. We are tearing ourselves apart from within, even as our many enemies hungrily eye our lands.
74.LeaveText: I do hope you find what you seek.
74.Name: Castle Sage

75.JoinText: Hey there.  What can I do ya for? I have a nice assortment of magical rings and items that can aid you, including enchanted maps that will never lose you!
75.Name: Mystic

76.SayText1: I've searched all my life for the famous and rare skeleton key, which opens any and every lock in the land.
76.SayText0: You may have met my brother Chuck around here.  He deals in non-exotic keys.  It's sad really.
76.SayText2: Some damn thief stole my bedroom key! You'd think, being a locksmith, I could make another, and you're probably right, but it's .. my uh, father's.. key.. who.. gave it to me.. for some.. reason.. AND THAT MAKES IT SENTIMENTAL! Go get it!
76.JoinText: Welcome to Locksmith Willy's Bargain Bonanza!
76.LeaveText: Be sure to come back!  I'm always looking for new and interesting keys!
76.Name: Locksmith Willy

77.JoinText: Welcome!  Hello!  And Good-day!  Welcome to the Banker Brothers Banking Company!  Saving's and loan's, interest and taxes!  We do it all!
77.LeaveText: Don't forget to do your taxes!  And come back soon!
77.Name: Banker Brothers

78.SayText1: Mary!  What are you doing out of your cage!  Get back in there before I whip out the switch!
78.SayText0: Ahh... don't I look great today?
78.SayText4: Sometimes.. when it's late... oh wait.. never mind.
78.SayText2: Yes.. you look nice too.. but you don't compare to my cuteness!
78.JoinText: Welcome to my weapon shop.  Feel free to look around, all my weapons are beautiful... just like me!
78.SayText3: Gosh.. am I not the smoothest guy you've ever met?
78.LeaveText: Come back again!  And remember, vanity is the mirror of the soul!
78.Name: Brandon

79.JoinText: Just type /buy to recieve your water.
79.Name: Waterboy

80.JoinText: Hello der, I'm Pirate Bob!  Would you like to go the Southern Docks on the Ancient Island?
80.Name: Pirate Bob

81.JoinText: Come.. Wouldn't you like to take a rest, adventurer?
81.Name: Sanguine Fiend

82.JoinText: Hey man I'm sure you'll get out! *wink wink*
82.LeaveText: We'll see you soon....i'm sure of it...*chuckles*
82.Name: Jail Guard

84.JoinText: Greetings, I am the Master Summoner of Shadecall. Prove your worth and I may share my knowledge with you.
84.Name: Master Summoner

85.SayText0: Yohoho, a bankers life for me!
85.JoinText: Ahoy, welcome to my bank matey. Aye, I be a retired pirate. And I figure I best start investing me fortune into those I have pillaged and plundered over me life. So come and share in the wealth!
85.Name: Banker Tidwits

86.JoinText: Welcome to my shop. Before you enter the Yeti's home, make sure you have a Glacial key, and Carved, Chiseled and Molded keys.
86.Name: Enchantress

87.SayText1: The hammer can be used by anyone, but the Tome can only be used by mages..
87.SayText0: The hammer can be used by anyone, but the Tome can only be used by mages..
87.SayText4: The hammer can be used by anyone, but the Tome can only be used by mages..
87.JoinText: Help! Please, release me! /Trade me the key and I'll give you a fantastic weapon!
87.SayText3: Find a way to release me and I shall give you one of my creations..
87.Name: Smithy Prisoner

88.SayText1: Use what is inside of you to succeed.
88.SayText0: The game is hard, but I am hard as well.
88.JoinText: Hello, my son.  You fight today like I once fought years ago.  If you have what it takes, I will supply you with equipment once used by myself.
88.LeaveText: Good bye, and remember, one person can be the difference between winning and losing.
88.Name: Old Champion

89.SayText4: You humans never leave me alone.
89.Name: Crendale Castle

90.SayText0: Daventry knew all along....how, oh how did he see before I?
90.JoinText: I have spent much time contemplating the clarity of my latest prescient experience, and I have come to a final conclusion.  I predict a severe malediction to fall upon our fine kingdom soon...from the east...I see much blood spilled...
90.LeaveText: Beware..it may be best not to let word get out just yet, as to not strike fear and panic into the kingdom. We must prepare, though, and always be ready.
90.Name: King's Oracle

91.JoinText: Ah...literature...one can never have enough.  I would be willing, myself, to give up one Good Book, though, if the I have good enough reason.
91.LeaveText: I have always been intruiged by the elves, and especially their literature.
91.Name: Vampire

92.JoinText: You know..I havn't been ta' church in years and years...I wish I had some Faith...I need to repent for stealing King Dekkar's boots...
92.Name: Sewer Hobo

93.JoinText: 'ey der sonny...wat is it yer doin' 'round her' see? i's a could real-e use some-fin' to help me walk y'kno how it is....*hack* *cough* all 'ey keen off'r ya is my last pack-o cig-o-rets...miners love 'em i know..us'd ta be one..
93.LeaveText: *hack* *topples over* *gags* *goes unconscious* *has a seizure* *breaks a hip*
93.Name: Wandrin' Geezer

94.JoinText: Oh! I fell down this treacherous well...*cries* I wish I had some way of climbing out of here.  The only way is a hooked rope though...and all i've got is a bottle of Evol...If you would be kind enough to lend me a rope and hook, walk infront of me..
94.Name: Timmy

95.JoinText: .pot eht morf taob driht eht otni dna kcod srediar ot ,tsaoc tsew eht ot ,tresed eht otni og
95.LeaveText: raeh i os nevaeh sretskcirt a s'ti
95.Name: Lrac

96.JoinText: So lonely...so lonely..nobody ever visits my pond anymore..not since all the hoo-ha babylon happenings nowadays.  I'd give anything for someone to pay attention to me!
96.LeaveText: Thank you so much for visiting me!
96.Name: Rusalka

97.JoinText: coasts...i love coasts....the tide rolling in...yes...the sand...THE SAND! I wish I could walk on water...yes, wish I do, wish I may, wish I will....
97.LeaveText: damn that King Dekkar.  all I wanted was to peacefully raid his kingdom and pillage and rape.....what's he do? lock me away like a CRIMINAL! WHAT IS THAT ALL ABOUT?!
97.Name: King Raider

99.JoinText: Welcome back! You can deposit your items or repair them here.
99.Name: Guild Servant

100.JoinText: We'll supply your guild needs! Items, banking, repairing, get it all right here!
100.LeaveText: Dont stop fighting until every single enemy guild is defeated!
100.Name: Underworld Shop

101.LeaveText: Good luck in your journey, may your new weapon bring death to your foes.
101.Name: Free Smithy

102.SayText1: I'm a Credit Man! Too bad you're not getting any here.
102.SayText0: The old manager, Pol, has messed up multiple times.. I'm his replacement.
102.SayText2: I'm a ruby kind of guy!
102.SayText3: Good credit, Bad credit, you get no credit here!
102.Name: Ness Atoui

103.SayText1: Did you know Calindor had a prince, they say he lived on and that his blood line still flows.
103.SayText0: Calindor will be grand once more!
103.SayText2: One day I was searching near the ice and found something that looked like an entrance, it was frozen shut though!
103.JoinText: Welcome, welcome Adventurer! Yes, I am a Blacksmith. You didn't know? I built the bridge near Dragonia! Well, please browse. Though it is not much.
103.LeaveText: Thank you for all of your help in rebuilding my home!
103.Name: Mr. Edwards

104.SayText1: Did you see the cave to the west? Do you think it could be the old mines?
104.SayText0: I hear there is a line of Calindorian Kings still living... just a rumor though.
104.SayText2: Ohh, scrub da dub, scrubbing the bar is oh so fun!
104.JoinText: Greetings M'lord, M'lady! Welcome to "Ye Olde Wolve" Tavern! If I can get ye anything, feel free to order ye'self a drink or meal. Ale is on the house tuesdays! Please bring books too! I love to read!
104.LeaveText: Come again M'lord, M'lady! Ye service is always welcome.
104.Name: Tiki

105.JoinText: Welcome to Nuclear Bombz Warp Facility, we have all the latest Nuclear Warping techniques. Feel free to purchase a ticket and try a warp!
105.Name: Nuclear Billy

106.SayText1: Oh my god, did you see what that knight wore in here?
106.SayText4: Aragorn was here once, he gave me a kiss!
106.SayText2: God, he was sooo sexy. I'd do him like a succubus!
106.JoinText: Hey there sweetypie, I am Jared. How ya doinnnn? Gosh, I just love when customers come to visit me! Feel free to sell me some lovin baby!
106.SayText3: Im pretty, oh so pretty, im pretty and witty and gay.
106.LeaveText: Oh gosh, please come back soon love!
106.Name: Jared

107.JoinText: Welcome to the Carnage Waiting Room.  This room offers banking and smithy services!
107.Name: Carnage Room

108.JoinText: Double-Click your equipment that you just got and it will go to the bottom row of your inventory, when it does, it is equipped. Next,  to attack, face the monster and press CTRL. If you're a mage, go to your 'Magic' tab and double-click your spell to fire
108.Name: Warteacher Leon

109.JoinText: To open vaults or locked doors, you need a key. Pick up the key next to this table by pressing Enter (when standing over it). To use it, double-click it while facing the door.
109.Name: Teacher Lasurid

110.JoinText: Hello, I am serving as interim King of Babylon during these dark days.. our King is missing! He went out on an adventure and has not returned. We have no idea of his whereabouts. Take this key and explore Babylon.. find our Lord!!!
110.LeaveText: Please, you are our only hope! I will watch over Babylon until our King is found.
110.Name: Babylonian Lord

111.JoinText: Ugh... Help me! I am the King of Babylon.. but I have been turned to stone by the King of the Underground Cult of Babylon... He is summoning a powerful Demon to destroy Babylon.. please save Babylon.. it is too late for me.. I am mortally.. wounded......
111.Name: Petrified King

112.JoinText: You have slain the Cult Guild Founder... The Demon cannot survive without the final sacrifice! Save yourself, it will die off soon, but it will still come after you! Escape!
112.LeaveText: Tell the Lord to take care of Babylon for me!!!!!
112.Name: Dying King

113.SayText0: Long ago the Kingdom of Babylon was located in another place... the Castle of Elders lies there..... use the key... to gain access... it wont be easy....
113.JoinText: I see... so the King died preventing the summoning of the Devil... I understand. I will watch over Babylon as the new king. You however, shall be rewarded greatly. Somewhere in this land is the ancient Castle of the Elders. Find it, and use this Key......
113.LeaveText: This key... can lead to the treasure of your life... or your death... it will be up to you from here on. I believe another key must be found to gain entry... long ago the Tundra land was a colony of Babylon, but we ungarissoned that horrible place....
113.Name: Babylon King

114.JoinText: Hello there. I see you have found this place. It is the ruins of babylon. Let me tell you the story of this place. Babylon was once a prosperous and great kingdom here. But barbarians invaded from across the western ocean. This area was destroyed in a war
114.LeaveText: Babylon put up a spirited fight at the castle and in the town. but the barbarians destroyed the walls and got in. It was a slaughter. The survivor's rebuilt far to the east. The castle is still up though. I believe it holds many mysteries.....
114.Name: Historian

115.JoinText: Hello there noble adventurer. I am the spirit that was left to watch over Elder Castle. Here I will remain for all time, watching over the ancient kingdom of Babylon. You may not enter this castle until you have completed the 2 great trials of Babylon.
115.LeaveText: Go and complete the Trials. I cannot tell you more information. Until you complete those trials, you will never see the inside of this castle!
115.Name: Spirit Guardian

116.JoinText: Hail there! I am a surviving Bablyon Colonist of this region. There are still a few people here who enjoy the hardships of life in the tundra. Recently there was a loud disturbance here, we think old passages may have resurfaced.
116.LeaveText: Be careful in here, this castle is so old it dates back to the days when Babylon ruled most of the entire world.
116.Name: Hardy Colonist

117.JoinText: Bahahahahaha another pathetic challenger has come for the key? Only one box contains the real key! But that does not matter, I will strike you dead before you ever find it!
117.LeaveText: COME BACK HERE, I'LL KILL YOU!!! Bah! No matter.. even if they get the keys... they have Him to deal with still.............
117.Name: Ice Wizard

118.SayText2: JUST DIE! DIE DIE DIE DIE DIE DIE.
118.JoinText: YOU HAVE COME FAR! I am impressed! But, how are you going to get by me? If you want my precious keepsake armor, you will have to fight me to the death!
118.Name: OdysseyChampion

119.JoinText: Welcome to Mr. Bunny's Trade Shop, Hippity Hippity Hop!
119.LeaveText: Thank you for your service, Hoppity Hoppity Hip!
119.Name: Mr. Bunny

120.SayText1: get back to work get back to work
120.SayText4: get back to work get back to work get back to work get back to work get back to work
120.SayText2: get back to work get back to work get back to work
120.JoinText: Welcome to your ultimate boring challenge.
120.SayText3: get back to work get back to work get back to work get back to work
120.Name: Captain Amazing

121.JoinText: Welcome to Jack's Casino, aye you may do your banking here if ye wish. Purchase coins from me as well.
121.Name: Banker Sam

122.JoinText: So, you want to learn magic, eh? First, walk counter-clockwise along the walls three times...

123.JoinText: Ahh, my most valued customer! Thank you again for my papa's journal, my doors are always open for you!
123.LeaveText: Please enjoy your delicious foodstuffs! Come again, friend!
123.Name: Happy Brockett

124.SayText1: I failed school, dyslexia my to due. This is why I'm a thief now!

144.SayText0: Yes, a murderer recently escaped from the prison. Until we have finished investigating, the prison is closed off to outsiders.

144.SayText2: We have hundreds of prisoners here. We receive them from all around. It is a little known fact that Dekkar actually pays us to accept and imprison his convicts.
144.JoinText: Welcome to the prison, we're not accepting visitors right now due to a recent breakout, but we will be again soon.
144.SayText3: The prison doubles as a vault. It was initially only an underground vault for storing wealth in, but we later expanded it since it is very safe and secure.

199.SayText1: I'm sorry for deceiving you, but you too are already benefitting from the Duck equipment.  We are brothers in this fight now.
199.SayText0: We only want to use the powers of the Ducks to help protect our own lands.
199.SayText2: The ducks are fierce and inside Ancient Island lives a terrible power that nobody has been able to successfully fight.
199.JoinText: Yes, it is I, the Easter Master.  I knew when I sent in the bunnies that this would create war between the ducks and the humans.  We only want to use their power to help protect our lands.  I'm sorry I hid my true purpose.
199.LeaveText: Come back anytime you want to exchange tokens for the genuine article!

200.SayText1: There is a maximum of five challengers that may enter.
200.SayText0: Before you even think about entering the Fire Lord's lair, you had better select only your finest and best equipped warriors.
200.SayText4: Maybe your party has what it takes to beat Lavos, but very few parties return the same. The greed, arrogance, and pride that unfolds can tear strong groups apart.
200.SayText2: I'll try to channel through the Fire Shield to keep your group from losing items and experience from within his fire chamber. Good luck!
200.JoinText: Well, what do we have here? Do you honestly think you have what it takes to defeat Lavos? If you enter, I will try my best to protect you from losing your items and experience.
200.SayText3: Admittingly, during my own raid, our warriors failed to realize that sheer might was not enough to win.
200.Name: Barbarian Chief
